meta.name: debugging
meta.description: MUST USE for any real runtime debugging across ANY language or binary — crashes, silent failures, wrong responses, stuck processes, memory leaks, async misbehavior, unexplained timing, reverse engineering. Runs a hypothesis-driven loop: form ≥3 hypotheses, investigate in parallel, after 2 failed rounds spawn Oracles from orthogonal angles, confirm root cause, lock with a failing test, fix minimally, QA by actually USING the system, scrub artifacts. The actual HOW lives in `references/` — READ THEM. Triggers: 'debug this', 'why is X not working', 'hanging', 'attach a debugger', 'reverse engineer', 'pwndbg', 'gdb', 'lldb', 'node inspect', 'pdb', 'dlv', 'delve', 'rust-gdb', 'set a breakpoint', 'context window exploded', 'why is the response empty', 'why is this happening', 'trace this bug', 'reproduce and fix', 'silent failure', 'HTTP 200 but empty', 'why did it stop', 'inspect the binary', 'playwright', 'flaky test', 'fails intermittently', 'passes in isolation', 'only fails in CI'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 定位并修复各类运行时故障，从崩溃到内存泄漏
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果 你常遭遇崩溃、泄漏或莫名失败却难以定位根因。
copy.tagline_en: Diagnose and fix any runtime failure, from crashes to memory leaks.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often face crashes, leaks, or unexplained failures and can't find the root cause.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按固定流程排查程序故障:先基于运行时现象同时提出多个可能原因并并行调查;确认根因后,先写出能复现问题的失败测试,再做最小修复;最后实际运行你的系统验证修好,并清理调试留下的临时文件。
howto.when: 当你使用「调试这个」「为什么 X 不工作」「复现并修复」等说法,或提到「卡住」「崩溃」「内存泄漏」等,或命令中出现 gdb、pwndbg、node inspect 等调试器名称时触发。

say.text: 帮我调试这个 Python 脚本,它偶发崩溃。
say.note: Claude 会先查 Python 调试参考,再按流程排查。

say.text: 接口返回 200 但内容是空的,怎么回事?
say.note: 这是技能明确列出的触发场景之一。

say.text: 用 Playwright 复现并修复这个网页点击 bug。
say.note: 浏览器场景会强制驱动真实浏览器验证。

howto.what_en: Claude runs a hypothesis-driven debug loop: forms ≥3 hypotheses, investigates in parallel, confirms root cause, writes a failing test, applies minimal fix, runs real QA, and scrubs artifacts.
howto.when_en: Triggers on 'debug this', 'why is X not working', 'reproduce and fix', or on hanging, crashes, memory leaks, reverse engineering; also when you name gdb, pwndbg, node inspect.

say_en.text: Help me debug this Python script; it crashes intermittently.
say_en.note: Claude reads the Python runtime reference first.

say_en.text: The API returns 200 but the body is empty — why?
Reproduce and fix this webpage click bug with Playwright.
say_en.note: Browser bugs are verified in a real browser.
